title: fix(console): the OAuth consent screen explains metadata:write and never shows an unknown scope bare
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb51xwoNvcyPQLyWAgj42Yro)_
Fixes #26587
Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** Console 的 OAuth 授权同意页(`/oauth/consent`)现在把 `metadata:write` 讲成一句话:「以草稿形式构建和修改此应用的元数据(不超出您自己的权限),由人来发布」,十种语言都有。页面不认识的 scope 显示为「无法识别的权限:xxx」,不再裸露原始字符串。
- **为什么改:** #26550 上线了 `metadata:write`,它是唯一能让 AI 客户端改动环境元数据的授权,却是同意页上唯一没有解释、只显示原始字符串的一项;用户在不知道授予了什么的情况下点「授权」。
- **风险与回滚:** 低。只改同意页的文案渲染和语言包两个新键;授权流程、提交内容不变。四个 MCP scope 的英文句子改为直接取自 `@objectstack/spec` 的 `MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_CONSENT_COPY`,与服务端声明一致。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/OAuthConsentPage.tsx` 的 `describeAgentScope`(对 `McpOauthScope` 穷尽的 switch)与 `default` 分支;`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/OAuthConsentPage.mcp-scopes-26587.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/OAuthConsentPage.mcp-scopes-26587.test.tsx`,预期 12 个用例全绿(英文逐句等于 spec 文案,其余九种语言均不出现原始 scope,未知 scope 显示为「无法识别的权限」)。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

**`@object-ui/console` — `OAuthConsentPage`.** The consent list used to map the three older agent scopes by hand and send everything else to `default: return scope`, so `metadata:write` (added by #26550) reached the user as its raw spelling. Now:

- `describeScope` routes every member of `MCP_OAUTH_SCOPES` to `describeAgentScope`, a switch that is exhaustive over `McpOauthScope` with no default. Each case reads its own pack key and passes `MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_CONSENT_COPY[scope]` (from `@objectstack/spec/ai`) as the `defaultValue`. A scope the spec adds without a case here fails the Console type-check instead of rendering unexplained.
- The `default` branch renders `oauth.consent.scope.unrecognised` ("Unrecognised permission: SCOPE"), per the triage ruling (comment 6438780502): "An unknown scope renders as an explicit "unrecognised permission", ⛔ never as a bare string."

**`@object-ui/i18n` — all ten locale packs.** Two keys under `oauth.consent.scope`: `metadataWrite` (the `en` value is byte-identical to the spec's sentence) and `unrecognised` (one `{{scope}}` placeholder). The `en` comment above the block now says where the agent-scope English comes from. `TranslationKeys = typeof en` widens by these two keys, hence `Clause-②: yes`.

**`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ai.json` — `ai.mcp-http-surface`, revision 6** (the second item the card carries; a devx file). Main at c739de75 still said "three" scopes. The acceptance[5] clause and its verify now name the four scopes the 403 body and the WWW-Authenticate `scope` list carry (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` joins `MCP_OAUTH_SCOPES`), steps[5] says "four", and the variants matrix gains the `metadata:write` row (the host-injected authoring tools, served only to an OAuth grant naming the scope, per `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`). History row added.

**Changeset:** `.changeset/26587-consent-metadata-write.md`, `patch` for `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/console`.

## Tests

- New: `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/OAuthConsentPage.mcp-scopes-26587.test.tsx`. It walks `MCP_OAUTH_SCOPES`, so a scope the spec adds is a subject the moment it lands. In `en` the rows equal `MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_CONSENT_COPY` in order. In each of the nine other built-in languages (catalogue loaded before the instance, so a missing key cannot hide behind the `en` fallback), no row contains the raw scope and no row equals the English sentence. An unknown scope renders through the `unrecognised` pack value in `en`, and in `zh` as a translated line that still names the scope.
- Updated: the `CONTROL` case of `OAuthConsentPage.agent-scopes-12853.test.tsx` pinned the old raw-string behaviour; it now asserts the unrecognised line.

## Acceptance notes

- The claim's file surface said "one new consent key"; the card's route also asks for a translated "unrecognised permission" line, so the packs gain two keys (`metadataWrite`, `unrecognised`).
- The `zh` / `ja` / … sentences for `metadataWrite` follow each pack's existing pattern for the other agent scopes (the permission bound in parentheses) and add the "a person publishes" clause; they are hand translations, not machine-checked.
- The Console now imports `@objectstack/spec/ai` from an eagerly loaded page. The constants live in a spec chunk that `@objectstack/spec/system` (already in the Console's dependency set) also reaches; the eager-closure byte cost was not measured locally and is left to CI's performance budget.
- `ai.json`: besides the clause the card names, steps[5] ("NONE of the three MCP scopes") and the variants matrix were also stale for the same reason and are corrected in the same revision.
